An '''electromagnetic neuro-shock field''' was created by the [[Ramp Entry Security System]] interacting with the natural conductive abilities of steps and ramps. Individuals caught in an electromagnetic [[neuro-shock]] field were [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] and rendered unconscious.<ref name="Ship Jackers">{{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref>
